citation: Chang et al. 2026. Phylotranscriptomics and genome-size evidence clarify the Taiwanese Cirsium japonicum complex and delimit C. brevicaule and allied East Asian thistles
coverage: 37 samples total; 33 Cirsium samples; Taiwan/Ryukyu/Japan focal sampling
usable_for: nuclear species-tree scaffold; lineage delimitation; leaf-transcriptome coding-integrity screen; verified visible corolla states
not_usable_for: petal expression; pigment chemistry; causal pollinator inference
notes: RNA was sampled from fresh leaves. The abstract/conclusion state a linkage of takaoense floral-colour polymorphism to anthocyanin expression and pollinator preference, but the searchable main Methods/Results describe morphology of the colour morphs rather than a petal-expression or pollinator experiment. Do not use that mechanistic claim until supplementary/source evidence is verified.

citation: Fan et al. 2026. Transposable Element-Mediated Structural Variation Drives Flower Colour Diversification in Camellia
coverage: 237 accessions; 11 de novo genomes; major Camellia flower-colour types
usable_for: published nuclear phylogenetic framework; visible-colour ancestral reconstruction; TE/SV regulatory mechanism; MYB60 anthocyanin-suppression evidence
not_usable_for: fully reproducible public-data reanalysis unless raw/tree data are recovered
notes: Paper infers a likely white-flowered Camellia MRCA using parsimony and likelihood on a nuclear SNP phylogeny. Early clades contain white/yellow/red states; later clades lack yellow. MYB60-associated TIR SV was functionally tested.

citation: Fan et al. 2026. A near telomere-to-telomere genome reveals yellow camellias evolution and flavonols biosynthesis
coverage: 79 accessions; 26 yellow Camellia from China; 18 from Vietnam; Camellia longruiensis gap-free phased genome
usable_for: yellow-lineage nuclear phylogeny; China-Vietnam comparison; C. cucphuongensis/C. flava distinct trajectory; WRKY23-to-FLS regulatory evidence
not_usable_for: public raw-data-only reanalysis unless sequence data are recovered
notes: Most yellow accessions form a major lineage, while C. cucphuongensis and C. flava cluster on a distinct trajectory. Molecular experiments support WRKY23 activation of FLS and flavonol accumulation in C. longruiensis.

citation: Zhou et al. 2013. Functional analyses of a flavonol synthase-like gene from Camellia nitidissima reveal its roles in flavonoid metabolism during floral pigmentation
usable_for: taxon-specific CnFLS1 function; flavonol accumulation; experimental flux competition with anthocyanin
notes: CnFLS1 overexpression in tobacco increased flavonols, reduced anthocyanins, and shifted flowers toward white/light yellow.

citation: Zhou et al. 2017. De novo Assembly of the Camellia nitidissima Transcriptome Reveals Key Genes of Flower Pigment Biosynthesis
coverage: five flower developmental stages; 15 flower samples
usable_for: public petal/flower RNA-seq; HPLC pigment evidence; carotenoid and flavonol pathway expression
notes: Golden-yellow petals contain both carotenoids and flavonol glycosides; this source falsifies any schema that equates yellow solely with a flavonol state.

citation: Feng et al. 2024. Multi-omics analysis revealed the mechanism underlying flavonol biosynthesis during petal color formation in Camellia nitidissima
usable_for: CnFLS2 petal expression; flavonol/anthocyanin developmental contrast; transient overexpression; JA-CnFLS2 regulation
notes: Flavonols rise during golden-petal formation while several anthocyanin/proanthocyanidin signals decline; CnFLS2 overexpression increases flavonol content.
